easy.def: To rest with your eyes closed.
examples: I sleep at night.
The baby is sleeping.
The cat slept all day.

more.def: To rest your body and mind with your eyes closed, as you do at night.
examples: Bears sleep through most of the winter.
I slept well after the long hike.
Please be quiet because the baby is sleeping.

easy.def: The rest you get at night.
examples: I need sleep.
She got a good sleep.
He fell into a deep sleep.

more.def: The natural rest that your body needs every night.
examples: Children need a lot of sleep to grow and learn.
I fell into a deep sleep as soon as my head touched the pillow.
A good night of sleep helps you feel ready for school.
Do not slip on the ice.
He slipped on the wet floor.
The soap slipped from my hand.

more.def: To slide by accident and almost fall, or to slide out of place.
examples: Be careful not to slip on the icy steps.
The cup slipped out of my wet hands.
She slipped on a banana peel in the cartoon.
She slipped out the door.
The cat slipped into the room.
He slipped away.

more.def: To move quietly or without being noticed.
examples: The cat slipped through the open door.
She slipped a note into his bag.
We slipped out of the room as the baby slept.

easy.def: So wet or smooth that you might slide.
examples: The ice is slippery.
The wet floor is slippery.
A fish is slippery to hold.

more.def: So smooth, wet, or icy that it is hard to hold or walk on.
examples: Be careful, because the floor is slippery when it is wet.
The soap was too slippery to hold.
Wet leaves made the sidewalk slippery.
A snail is slow.
The slow bus is late.
The turtle is slow.

more.def: Moving or happening at a low speed, or taking a long time.
examples: The snail made slow progress across the garden.
We were stuck behind a slow truck.
The line at the store was slow.
Slow down, please.
The bus slowed at the corner.
Cars slow near the school.

more.def: To lower the speed of something, or to move at a lower speed.
examples: The driver slowed the car at the crosswalk.
Please slow down before the corner.
Rain slowed the runners.
